summary: The validate service now adds a source `line` to every error whose JSON pointer maps (relation-triple errors included) via a lazy second parse with the `yaml` package; type errors on one-line scalars read `firmware: 9e10234 (parsed as float Infinity) is not of expected type string`, and arch-validate prints `line N: ` before the message (unchanged output for line-less errors). Committed as Architecture 2dcf07b on phase/041-P1; service build and test gates green.
